title.zh: Meta Muse六周用户破千万，AI购物平均订单超200美元
title.en: Meta Muse六周用户破千万，AI购物平均订单超200美元

current_state.zh: Meta reported that its personal AI agent Muse amassed over 10 million accounts in about six weeks across the US and Canada, with shopping the top use case at over $200 average order value, while quarterly capex of $34.9B pushed free cash flow to -$2.1B.
